elements.element: New York law governs the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 27.1 expressly states: “This Agreement is governed by New York law.”

elements.element: State and federal courts in New York County have exclusive jurisdiction over the merits, subject only to temporary injunctive relief elsewhere.
elements.evidence: Section 27.1 grants exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County. No exception for proceedings elsewhere exists, so the exclusivity is broader than the permitted temporary-injunctive-relief carve-out and necessarily covers the merits.

elements.element: The governing law is Delaware, California, or England and Wales.
elements.evidence: The Agreement selects New York law, not Delaware, California, or England and Wales law.

elements.element: The dispute forum is the corresponding Delaware or California courts, or the courts of London for England and Wales law.
elements.evidence: The selected forum is the state and federal courts in New York County, not any permitted fallback forum.
